name: atum-examples
description: Root orchestration for the Atum x402, MPP, and Payment Gateway examples. Each example is a standalone project; these scripts just install, typecheck, and test them all together.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix x402-make-payments && npm install --prefix mpp-make-payments && npm install --prefix x402-accept-payments && npm install --prefix mpp-accept-payments && npm install --prefix pgc-make-payments
scripts.ci:all: npm ci --prefix x402-make-payments && npm ci --prefix mpp-make-payments && npm ci --prefix x402-accept-payments && npm ci --prefix mpp-accept-payments && npm ci --prefix pgc-make-payments
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix x402-make-payments run typecheck && npm --prefix mpp-make-payments run typecheck && npm --prefix x402-accept-payments run typecheck && npm --prefix mpp-accept-payments run typecheck && npm --prefix pgc-make-payments run typecheck
scripts.test:smoke: npm --prefix x402-make-payments test && npm --prefix mpp-make-payments test && npm --prefix x402-accept-payments test && npm --prefix mpp-accept-payments test && npm --prefix pgc-make-payments test
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:mpp; m=$?; npm run test:e2e:x402; x=$?; npm run test:e2e:pgc; p=$?; exit $(( m | x | p ))
scripts.test:all: npm run test:smoke && npm run test:e2e
